## Who We Are

Horizon Powered is a next-generation global manufacturer of wireless access devices for private LTE,
CBRS, and 5G networks.  We are last-mile connected solutions experts. We empower enterprises,
industrial facilities, service providers, and mission-critical installations to accelerate,
automate, and amplify private wireless rollout.

Our **[CBRS-ready product line][88]** — consisting of **[indoor routers][89], [outdoor ruggedized
CPEs][90], [mobile hotspots][91]**, and plug-and-play **[USB dongles][92]** — offers the control,
performance, and flexibility required to connect any device to your CBRS network infrastructure.
Backed by unmatched technical expertise and global delivery presence, Horizon Powered helps
organizations develop high-performance, dependable private networks for today’s connected world.

Helping the UK get online and get the most from their home broadband, since 2018

## Our mission

With the amount of things we now do online, we believe that broadband is an essential service, just
like electricity or water.

Our mission is to help everyone in the UK get a fast, stable broadband connection, for a reasonable
price.

[Broadband Savvy favicon.]

illustration]

broadband.

VIRTUAL SILENT AUCTION [CLICK HERE TO START BIDDING][15]

## MiFi Distribution Program

The MiFi Distribution Program is a collaboration with the City of Durham and Durham County that
provides eligible households with internet-enabled devices. The households that qualify for the MiFi
Hotspot will receive **FREE INTERNET **services for a limited time.

The Digital Inclusion Services Division is dedicated to bridging the digital divide and ensuring
that all residents have access to essential digital resources and services.

#### **Important things to know:**

****
* The survey is available in English and Spanish.
* Device distribution begins in September 2025 and will continue monthly while supplies last.
* Residents who qualify for the program will receive an email notification with the deployment dates
  and location to pick up the device.

[Click to Learn More][16]

## “As technologies evolve, Digital Inclusion requires intentional strategies and investments to
## reduce and eliminate historical, institutional and structural barriers to access and use
## technology.”

## MiFi Distribution Program

The MiFi Distribution Program is a collaboration with the City of Durham and Durham County that
provides eligible households with internet-enabled devices. The households that qualify for the MiFi
Hotspot will receive **FREE INTERNET **services for a limited time.

The Digital Inclusion Services Division is dedicated to bridging the digital divide and ensuring
that all residents have access to essential digital resources and services.

#### **Important things to know:**

****
* The survey is available in English and Spanish.
* Device distribution begins in September 2025 and will continue monthly while supplies last.
* Residents who qualify for the program will receive an email notification with the deployment dates
  and location to pick up the device.

[Click to Learn More][16]

[ GET A QUOTE ][32]
[ ABOUT US ][33]

# Our Services

Cerapproval is ISO 9001:2015 accredited and DUNS registered in the US, ensuring our commitment to
quality and global standards.

[ ][34] [ ][35]

###### SDPPI DJID POSTEL CERTIFICATION

Our services is specifically designed for manufactures, importers, distributors, testing
laboratories, overseas type approval agencies and consultants who are seeking SDPPI 

[ ][36] [ ][37]

###### SNI Certification Assistance

We can help you to obtain an SNI License which it could guarantee the quality of the products you
produce, so that the product value could increase and open up wider market opportunities.

[ ][38] [ ][39]

###### TKDN CERTIFICATION ASSISTANCE

We can help you get TKDN Type Approval, Indonesia Telecommunication and ICT Regulation in english
language related to Indonesia Type Approval and other.

[ ][40] [ ][41]

###### Laboratory Testing Services

We provide services to test your telecommunication product for SDPPI Type Approval such: W-lan
(802.11a/b/g/n a/c), RFID, Security router, Analog Modem, Low Power Device, and etc.

[ ][42] [ ][43]

###### MKG (Warranty Card Manual)

We assist in obtaining a Warranty Card Manual, which includes user instructions and after-sales
warranty cards specifically for telematics and electronic products. 

[ ][44] [ ][45]

###### Company License and Legality

We can help you to get  company license and legality approval, such Perizinan Impor, Tanda
Pendaftaran Tipe Produk, Angka Pengenal Importir Umum, Tanda Daftar Perusahaan, Surat Izin Usaha
Perdagangan, NPWP Domisili Perusahaan, Nomor Identitas Kepabeanan

[ ][46] [ ][47]

###### K3L (Health, Safety, and Environment)

We facilitate the application process for the K3L Certificate. K3L encompasses a set of regulations,
procedures, and systems designed to safeguard workers and the environment from potential risks
during work processes.

[ ][48] [ ][49]

###### SIMAKESPEL BTKP

We provide assistance in obtaining the SIMAKESPEL Certificate. This certificate is part of the
Maritime Safety Equipment Management System, developed by the Maritime Safety Technology Center
(BTKP), to ensure compliance with maritime safety standards.

# What Is Cerapproval

Cerapproval is already accredited with ISO 9001:2015 and DUNS registered in US. We support the
largest telecommunications equipment manufacturers in the world and future’s industry leaders in
obtaining type approval through our network, you can visit [Cerapproval Indonesia][50] in Bahasa
Indonesia.

# Our Client

With a strong reputation and years of experience, our client has built a solid presence in the
industry by consistently delivering high-quality solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of
its customers. The company values integrity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and it
strives to create long-term value for stakeholders through strategic initiatives and sustainable
practices.

quality and global standards.

[ ][34] [ ][35]

laboratories, overseas type approval agencies and consultants who are seeking SDPPI 

[ ][36] [ ][37]

We can help you to obtain an SNI License which it could guarantee the quality of the products you
produce, so that the product value could increase and open up wider market opportunities.

[ ][38] [ ][39]

###### TKDN CERTIFICATION ASSISTANCE

We can help you get TKDN Type Approval, Indonesia Telecommunication and ICT Regulation in english
language related to Indonesia Type Approval and other.

[ ][40] [ ][41]

We provide services to test your telecommunication product for SDPPI Type Approval such: W-lan
(802.11a/b/g/n a/c), RFID, Security router, Analog Modem, Low Power Device, and etc.

[ ][42] [ ][43]

###### MKG (Warranty Card Manual)

We assist in obtaining a Warranty Card Manual, which includes user instructions and after-sales
warranty cards specifically for telematics and electronic products. 

[ ][44] [ ][45]

###### Company License and Legality

We can help you to get  company license and legality approval, such Perizinan Impor, Tanda
Pendaftaran Tipe Produk, Angka Pengenal Importir Umum, Tanda Daftar Perusahaan, Surat Izin Usaha
Perdagangan, NPWP Domisili Perusahaan, Nomor Identitas Kepabeanan

[ ][46] [ ][47]

###### K3L (Health, Safety, and Environment)

We facilitate the application process for the K3L Certificate. K3L encompasses a set of regulations,
procedures, and systems designed to safeguard workers and the environment from potential risks
during work processes.

We provide assistance in obtaining the SIMAKESPEL Certificate. This certificate is part of the
Maritime Safety Equipment Management System, developed by the Maritime Safety Technology Center
(BTKP), to ensure compliance with maritime safety standards.

### Yealink T3 Series IP Phones

Yealink new T3 series is a classic and cost-effective entry-level business IP phone for daily
desktop voice communications. 5-way local conference function, EHS wireless headset supporting, and
proven integration of Yealink Device Management Platform, T3 series maximizes productivity and
enhances collaboration for businesses of various scales.

### Yeastar P-Series PBX System

P-Series PBX System delivers more than SMEs expect from any average business phone system in terms
of functionalities. From the must-haves to the nice-to-haves, the full feature set can handle not
only daily business calls but also sophisticated call operations, catering to a vast majority of
SMEs’ communication needs at the competitive price.

### MS Teams Rooms System

Yealink MVC II series video conferencing solutions specially designed for Microsoft Teams rooms. It
provides a full-scene VC solution to cover all of the meeting rooms from extra-large to small size.
Designed with the idea of multi-function all-in-one, that allows you easily perform call control,
camera control, content sharing and other functions.

# 4G/5G CPE, MiFi and FWA Router Manufacturer for Global Operators

Honlly Telecom designs and manufactures LTE/5G indoor CPE, outdoor CPE, MiFi hotspots, WiFi routers
and industrial routers for ISPs, operators, MVNOs and distributors that need reliable hardware,
flexible branding and scalable production.

## Our Company

Founded in 2009, professional 4G/5G MBB device manufacturer.

### Partners

Cooperate with 90+ operators in more than 75 countries.

## Trusted by 90+ Operators Across 75+ Countries

Since 2009, Honlly Telecom has been a reliable OEM/ODM partner for fixed wireless access (FWA)
devices. Our factory in Xiamen, China, delivers carrier-grade 4G and 5G CPE to operators, ISPs, and
distributors globally.

2009Year Founded

Over 15 years of R&D and manufacturing experience in mobile broadband devices.

90+Operator Partners

Trusted by telecom operators and ISPs for white-label and custom CPE solutions.

75+Countries Served

Deployed across Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia, and Latin America.

## Hot-Selling Products

A selection of Honlly’s best-selling 4G/5G CPE and MiFi devices. Each model is available for OEM/ODM
customization with flexible MOQ, custom branding, and firmware adaptation.

### [HL-830M — 5G NR Indoor CPE][12]

WiFi 6 (802.11ax) indoor 5G router with SA/NSA dual-mode, up to 3.4 Gbps downlink, and multi-gigabit
LAN. Ideal for carrier FWA deployment.

[View Details][13]
[[HL-875H 5G NR Mobile WiFi hotspot]][14]

### [HL-875H — 5G NR Mobile WiFi][15]

Pocket-sized 5G MiFi hotspot with detachable battery, touchscreen display, and WiFi 6. Supports up
to 32 users simultaneously.

[View Details][16]
[[HL-620 LTE CAT6 Indoor CPE with carrier aggregation]][17]

### [HL-620 — LTE CAT6 Indoor CPE][18]

Mid-range CAT6 router with 2CA carrier aggregation, 300 Mbps peak downlink, dual-band WiFi, and FOTA
upgrade support.

[[HL-550A LTE CAT4 Indoor CPE router]][20]

Entry-level CAT4 indoor router with 150 Mbps downlink, dual Ethernet ports, and VoIP RJ11.
Cost-effective solution for emerging market broadband.

[View Details][22]
[[HL-580Z LTE CAT4 Indoor CPE for Africa market]][23]

### [HL-580Z — LTE CAT4 Africa CPE][24]

Region-optimized CAT4 indoor CPE tailored for African operator bands. Robust RF design for
challenging network environments.

[View Details][25]
[[HL-410A LTE CAT4 pocket MiFi hotspot]][26]

### [HL-410A — LTE CAT4 Mobile WiFi][27]

Ultra-portable LTE CAT4 pocket hotspot with detachable 3000 mAh battery, supporting up to 10 WiFi
users. Perfect for travel and mobile office use.

[View Details][28]

## OEM/ODM Manufacturing — Built for Global Operators

Honlly Telecom provides end-to-end OEM/ODM services for wireless router and CPE projects. From
industrial design and PCB layout to firmware development, certification, and packaging, our
engineering team delivers turnkey solutions that meet carrier requirements.

### Custom Hardware Design

Full ID/MD design, PCB schematic and layout, antenna tuning, and BOM optimization. We adapt chipset
platforms from Qualcomm, MediaTek, UNISOC, and ASR to your target specifications.

### Firmware & Software Customization

Custom OpenWrt/Linux-based firmware, TR-069/TR-369 remote management integration, operator-specific
UI/UX branding, FOTA OTA upgrade, and API development.

### Global Certification Support

CE, FCC, RoHS, REACH, GCF, PTCRB, and operator-specific certification. Our in-house lab accelerates
compliance testing and reduces time-to-market.

### Flexible Manufacturing

Scalable production lines with flexible MOQ, custom packaging and labeling, regional power adapter
variants, and multilingual user manuals.

## Why Partner with Honlly Telecom

### 15+ Years of CPE Expertise

Founded in 2009, Honlly has focused exclusively on mobile broadband devices for over a decade. Our
engineering team brings deep domain knowledge in 3GPP standards, RF design, and embedded Linux
systems.

### Operator-Grade Quality

Products are designed, tested, and certified to meet carrier-grade requirements. We maintain ISO
9001 quality management and operate a full in-house reliability testing lab.

## OEM/ODM Manufacturing — Built for Global Operators

Honlly Telecom provides end-to-end OEM/ODM services for wireless router and CPE projects. From
industrial design and PCB layout to firmware development, certification, and packaging, our
engineering team delivers turnkey solutions that meet carrier requirements.

### Custom Hardware Design

Full ID/MD design, PCB schematic and layout, antenna tuning, and BOM optimization. We adapt chipset
platforms from Qualcomm, MediaTek, UNISOC, and ASR to your target specifications.

### Firmware & Software Customization

Custom OpenWrt/Linux-based firmware, TR-069/TR-369 remote management integration, operator-specific
UI/UX branding, FOTA OTA upgrade, and API development.

### Global Certification Support

CE, FCC, RoHS, REACH, GCF, PTCRB, and operator-specific certification. Our in-house lab accelerates
compliance testing and reduces time-to-market.

### Flexible Manufacturing

Scalable production lines with flexible MOQ, custom packaging and labeling, regional power adapter
variants, and multilingual user manuals.

## Why Partner with Honlly Telecom

### 15+ Years of CPE Expertise

Founded in 2009, Honlly has focused exclusively on mobile broadband devices for over a decade. Our
engineering team brings deep domain knowledge in 3GPP standards, RF design, and embedded Linux
systems.

### Operator-Grade Quality

Products are designed, tested, and certified to meet carrier-grade requirements. We maintain ISO
9001 quality management and operate a full in-house reliability testing lab.

### National High-Tech Enterprise

Recognized as a 2024 National High-Tech Enterprise by the Chinese government, validating our R&D
investment, innovation capability, and technology commercialization track record.

### End-to-End Partnership

From initial concept and prototyping through mass production, certification, logistics, and
post-sales support, Honlly serves as a single point of accountability for your CPE supply chain.

FAQs

## Frequently asked questions

## What factors should I consider when choosing a college?

Consider factors such as the academic programs offered, campus culture, location, size of the
student body, extracurricular activities, and available resources. Think about your personal
preferences, career goals, and the type of environment that will help you thrive academically and
personally.

## How can I determine the affordability of a college education?

Assess the total cost of attendance, including tuition, fees, room and board, and other
miscellaneous expenses. Research available financial aid options, such as scholarships, grants, and
work-study programs. Compare the net cost after financial aid is taken into account. Additionally,
explore opportunities for part-time work or internships that can help offset expenses.

## What are the key application requirements and deadlines for college admissions?

Research the specific admission requirements for each college, including standardized test scores,
GPA, letters of recommendation, and personal statements. Be aware of application deadlines, as they
may vary between institutions. It's important to start the application process early to ensure you
have enough time to gather necessary documents and meet all requirements.

## What services can I expect from an immigration consultant?

Understand the specific services offered by the consultant. This may include assessing your
eligibility, preparing and reviewing application documents, providing guidance on required
supporting documents, and representing you in communications with immigration authorities. Clarify
the consultant's role in the process and the extent of their support, so you have a clear
understanding of what to expect throughout the immigration process.

## What are the fees and costs associated with hiring an immigration consultant?

Inquire about the consultant's fee structure upfront, including any additional costs such as
government fees, translation services, or courier charges. Ensure transparency regarding payment
methods and the breakdown of charges. Be cautious of consultants who demand large upfront fees
without clear explanations of the services provided.

## How can I find a reputable immigration consultant?

Look for consultants who are registered or accredited with relevant immigration authorities in the
destination country. Check for reviews and testimonials from previous clients. Seek recommendations
from friends, family, or colleagues who have successfully used immigration consultants. Research the
consultant's credentials, experience, and success rate in handling cases similar to yours.

Mitsubishi International Food Ingredients, Inc. has solid and reliable connections with domestic and
global ingredient supplier partners to help CPG companies, from corporations to small mom and pop

refining our products and services to elevate your business. Among our many product offerings, our
customized seasoning blends exemplify our strengths in formulation and applications. Through
partnerships with R&D, we strive to deliver consistency in seasoning notes and flavor profiles for a
wide range of applications, including meat, snack seasonings, sauces, dressings, side dishes,
functional blends, and bakery mixes. This is just one example of how we remain committed to
providing innovative product solutions for every customer, every time,

the food, nutraceutical and other selected markets in the United States, Canada, and other
countries.

To anticipate market demands and offer innovative, quality, safe, healthy, value-added ingredients
to satisfy consumer demands.

**Mission 2: Deliver Beyond Expectations**
To continuously provide extra value to our customers, suppliers, employees, shareholders, and

# SoftPerfect Software Products

[[Network Scanner icon]][27]
[SoftPerfect Network Scanner][28]

[Windows macOS Linux][29]

[Download Free Trial][30]

A universal IPv4/IPv6 scanner that can ping computers, scan ports, discover shared folders and comes
with flexible filtering and display options. It can retrieve practically any information about
network devices via WMI, SNMP, HTTP, SSH and PowerShell, and has many other features.

[[RAM Disk icon]][31]
[SoftPerfect RAM Disk][32]

[Windows macOS Linux][33]

[Download Free Trial][34]

A high-performance RAM disk application that lets you have a disk on your computer entirely stored
in the memory. As the memory is much faster than physical drives, it is much more efficient to store
temporary data on a fast in-memory disk. This achieves a higher performance and reduces strain put
on HDD or SSD thus prolonging their life.

[[RAM File System icon]][35]
[SoftPerfect RAM File System][36]

[Windows][37]

[Download Free Trial][38]

The next generation of RAM disk technology: a native in-memory file system that stores files
directly in RAM, with features like instant reflink copies and transparent compression, and with no
virtual block device or NTFS/exFAT layer in the way. Faster than any SSD and faster than a
conventional RAM disk, it is ideal for temporary files and caches.

[[NetWorx icon]][39]
[SoftPerfect NetWorx][40]

[Windows macOS Linux][41]

[Download Free Trial][42]

A simple yet versatile tool that helps you monitor your Internet connection. It can collect usage
data, monitor connection quality and measure the speed of your Internet. You can monitor a local
network adapter or your router, or track the applications on your computer that access the Internet.
All that with historical usage data and real time supervision.

[[NetGenius icon]][43]
[SoftPerfect NetGenius][44]

[Windows][45]

[Download Free Trial][46]

An easy to use tool for monitoring and controlling Internet usage of each application. Watch the
apps using your Internet in real-time, set limits to their bandwidth, prioritise important
applications, restrict less important programs, and block the ones you don't trust. Get detailed
usage reports, optimise your data consumption, and achieve better privacy and security.

[[WiFi Guard icon]][47]
[SoftPerfect WiFi Guard][48]

[Windows macOS Linux][49]

[Download Free Trial][50]

An essential tool for everyone running a small WiFi network and striving to keep it secure. It lets
you know immediately if your network is used without your knowledge. As a specialised network

## Global B2B Sourcing, Manufacturing & Supply Chain Solutions Platform

WIDQ is a global B2B sourcing and procurement platform that helps businesses discover high-potential
product opportunities, validate market potential, and transform ideas into scalable products through
product research, development, OEM/ODM manufacturing, and integrated supply chain solutions.

By integrating product development, sourcing capabilities, manufacturing resources, and global
supply chain networks, WIDQ enables businesses to transform ideas into market-ready products through
a structured and scalable B2B solution ecosystem.

Product research insights, demand analytics, WIDQ Index scoring, profit and cost analysis, market
pricing benchmarks, competition analysis, supplier discovery, and product risk evaluation — all
integrated into one B2B wholesale platform.

* ### Product Application
  
  The CableFree range of LTE CPE devices includes indoor and outdoor devices (China 4G CPE, 4G
  Router Suppliers, LTE Router Manufacturers) to allow operators to construct LTE networks to meet a
  wide range of user and application requirements. Outdoor CPEs are ideal to connect fixed
  locations, residential and business customers with “XDSL” replacement for rural broadband and also
  resilience for existing copper and fibre leased lines.
* ### Production Market
  
  Yaojin Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd has been a professional China 4G CPE, 4G Router Suppliers,
  LTE Router Manufacturers, providing 4G Mobile data solutions to more than 40 countries, dedicated
  to long-term cooperations with telecom and mobile operators worldwide.

  Our reputation rests equally on our creative design approach, as well as our technical expertise
  and attention to detail to turn your visions into reality. We pride ourselves on delivering a
  proactive service designed to ensure we meet your needs consistently. We monitor our service

  the industry. You are at the center of everything we do and we look forward to helping you.

# Become Broadband Savvy

Helping the UK get online and get the most from their home broadband, since 2018

## Our mission

With the amount of things we now do online, we believe that broadband is an essential service, just
like electricity or water.

Our mission is to help everyone in the UK get a fast, stable broadband connection, for a reasonable
price.

[Broadband Savvy favicon.]

## Our work

[Online content computer screen and mouse illustration][Online content computer screen and mouse
illustration]

### Online Content

We explain broadband concepts and issues on our website and YouTube channel, helping people get
online and troubleshoot their connection.

[Advocacy person appearing on television with speech bubble illustration][Advocacy person appearing
on television with speech bubble illustration]

### Advocacy & Commentary

We help media outlets, local councils, and community organisations educate their audiences and
consistituents.

[Support and advice hand with speech bubble illustration][Support and advice hand with speech bubble
illustration]

### Support & Advice

We provide individual advice to those who need help fixing, setting up, or understanding their home
broadband.

# 4G/5G CPE, MiFi and FWA Router Manufacturer for Global Operators

Honlly Telecom designs and manufactures LTE/5G indoor CPE, outdoor CPE, MiFi hotspots, WiFi routers

devices. Our factory in Xiamen, China, delivers carrier-grade 4G and 5G CPE to operators, ISPs, and
distributors globally.

customization with flexible MOQ, custom branding, and firmware adaptation.

LAN. Ideal for carrier FWA deployment.

industrial design and PCB layout to firmware development, certification, and packaging, our
engineering team delivers turnkey solutions that meet carrier requirements.

platforms from Qualcomm, MediaTek, UNISOC, and ASR to your target specifications.

UI/UX branding, FOTA OTA upgrade, and API development.

### Global Certification Support

CE, FCC, RoHS, REACH, GCF, PTCRB, and operator-specific certification. Our in-house lab accelerates
compliance testing and reduces time-to-market.

### Flexible Manufacturing

Scalable production lines with flexible MOQ, custom packaging and labeling, regional power adapter
variants, and multilingual user manuals.

### 15+ Years of CPE Expertise

Founded in 2009, Honlly has focused exclusively on mobile broadband devices for over a decade. Our
engineering team brings deep domain knowledge in 3GPP standards, RF design, and embedded Linux
systems.

Products are designed, tested, and certified to meet carrier-grade requirements. We maintain ISO
9001 quality management and operate a full in-house reliability testing lab.

FAQs

## Frequently asked questions

## What factors should I consider when choosing a college?

Consider factors such as the academic programs offered, campus culture, location, size of the
student body, extracurricular activities, and available resources. Think about your personal
preferences, career goals, and the type of environment that will help you thrive academically and
personally.

## How can I determine the affordability of a college education?

Assess the total cost of attendance, including tuition, fees, room and board, and other
miscellaneous expenses. Research available financial aid options, such as scholarships, grants, and
work-study programs. Compare the net cost after financial aid is taken into account. Additionally,
explore opportunities for part-time work or internships that can help offset expenses.

## What are the key application requirements and deadlines for college admissions?

Research the specific admission requirements for each college, including standardized test scores,
GPA, letters of recommendation, and personal statements. Be aware of application deadlines, as they
may vary between institutions. It's important to start the application process early to ensure you
have enough time to gather necessary documents and meet all requirements.

## What services can I expect from an immigration consultant?

Understand the specific services offered by the consultant. This may include assessing your
eligibility, preparing and reviewing application documents, providing guidance on required
supporting documents, and representing you in communications with immigration authorities. Clarify
the consultant's role in the process and the extent of their support, so you have a clear
understanding of what to expect throughout the immigration process.

## What are the fees and costs associated with hiring an immigration consultant?

Inquire about the consultant's fee structure upfront, including any additional costs such as
government fees, translation services, or courier charges. Ensure transparency regarding payment
methods and the breakdown of charges. Be cautious of consultants who demand large upfront fees
without clear explanations of the services provided.

## How can I find a reputable immigration consultant?

Look for consultants who are registered or accredited with relevant immigration authorities in the
destination country. Check for reviews and testimonials from previous clients. Seek recommendations
from friends, family, or colleagues who have successfully used immigration consultants. Research the
consultant's credentials, experience, and success rate in handling cases similar to yours.

### international food, custom seasoning blends, nutritional, and pharmaceutical ingredients for the

Lactoferrin is the most abundant protein found in human colostrum, lactoferrin sequesters and
delivers iron where it is needed most.  effera™ is an ideal ingredient for women’s health, gut
health, and active nutrition formulations, offering superior bioavailability and unique benefits in

# What We Do

Mitsubishi International Food Ingredients, Inc. has solid and reliable connections with domestic and
global ingredient supplier partners to help CPG companies, from corporations to small mom and pop
shops, customize formulas to match or create value-added finished product goods.

Our commitment to excellence reflects our approach to creating value for our customers and
delivering unparalleled products and services. We focus on the unique needs of every customer,
refining our products and services to elevate your business. Among our many product offerings, our
customized seasoning blends exemplify our strengths in formulation and applications. Through
partnerships with R&D, we strive to deliver consistency in seasoning notes and flavor profiles for a
wide range of applications, including meat, snack seasonings, sauces, dressings, side dishes,
functional blends, and bakery mixes. This is just one example of how we remain committed to
providing innovative product solutions for every customer, every time,

**Vision: Source global ingredients, locally**
To be a significant and unique supplier of a broad range of globally sourced quality ingredients to
the food, nutraceutical and other selected markets in the United States, Canada, and other
countries.

**Mission 1: Be an Innovative Leader**
To anticipate market demands and offer innovative, quality, safe, healthy, value-added ingredients
to satisfy consumer demands.

**Mission 2: Deliver Beyond Expectations**
To continuously provide extra value to our customers, suppliers, employees, shareholders, and
society.

**Mission 3: Operate to Meet the Highest Standards**
To conduct business fully complying with legal plus industrial requirements at the highest level of
ethical behavior in a socially responsible and environmentally friendly fashion.

distribute 1,000+ food, nutritional, and pharmaceutical products to customers nationwide. All of
MIFI’s GMP warehouses are food-grade and FDA-registered. All partnered LTL and TL trucks, equipment,
and processes adhere to all federal and state requirements. Carriers have damage prevention programs
in place to maintain product integrity and ensure compliant delivery. Our warehouses are prepared
and well-stocked, over 90 percent of our customers receive next-day service.

Our customers have always been our first priority. We consider customer relationships our greatest
asset. Your calls are not transferred to a third-party call center or an automated phone system. You
will never have a long wait queue to speak to a real human who is empowered to help you. We
guarantee you will always receive one-on-one, dedicated, and committed customer service. The best in
B2B customer care begins here.

possible.

# SoftPerfect Software Products

[[Network Scanner icon]][27]
[SoftPerfect Network Scanner][28]

[Windows macOS Linux][29]

[Download Free Trial][30]

A universal IPv4/IPv6 scanner that can ping computers, scan ports, discover shared folders and comes
with flexible filtering and display options. It can retrieve practically any information about
network devices via WMI, SNMP, HTTP, SSH and PowerShell, and has many other features.

[[RAM Disk icon]][31]
[SoftPerfect RAM Disk][32]

[Windows macOS Linux][33]

[Download Free Trial][34]

A high-performance RAM disk application that lets you have a disk on your computer entirely stored
in the memory. As the memory is much faster than physical drives, it is much more efficient to store
temporary data on a fast in-memory disk. This achieves a higher performance and reduces strain put
on HDD or SSD thus prolonging their life.

[[RAM File System icon]][35]
[SoftPerfect RAM File System][36]

[Windows][37]

[Download Free Trial][38]

The next generation of RAM disk technology: a native in-memory file system that stores files
directly in RAM, with features like instant reflink copies and transparent compression, and with no
virtual block device or NTFS/exFAT layer in the way. Faster than any SSD and faster than a
conventional RAM disk, it is ideal for temporary files and caches.

[[NetWorx icon]][39]
[SoftPerfect NetWorx][40]

[Windows macOS Linux][41]

[Download Free Trial][42]

A simple yet versatile tool that helps you monitor your Internet connection. It can collect usage
data, monitor connection quality and measure the speed of your Internet. You can monitor a local
network adapter or your router, or track the applications on your computer that access the Internet.
All that with historical usage data and real time supervision.

[[NetGenius icon]][43]
[SoftPerfect NetGenius][44]

[Windows][45]

[Download Free Trial][46]

An easy to use tool for monitoring and controlling Internet usage of each application. Watch the
apps using your Internet in real-time, set limits to their bandwidth, prioritise important
applications, restrict less important programs, and block the ones you don't trust. Get detailed
usage reports, optimise your data consumption, and achieve better privacy and security.

[[WiFi Guard icon]][47]
[SoftPerfect WiFi Guard][48]

[Windows macOS Linux][49]

[Download Free Trial][50]

An essential tool for everyone running a small WiFi network and striving to keep it secure. It lets
you know immediately if your network is used without your knowledge. As a specialised network
monitoring app, it runs through your network at set intervals and alerts you if it has found any
unrecognised connected devices that could possibly belong to an intruder.

[[Switch Port Mapper icon]][51]
[SoftPerfect Switch Port Mapper][52]

[Windows macOS Linux][53]

[Download Free Trial][54]

A network administration tool for troubleshooting network connectivity issues. It works with managed
network switches and reports what is connected to switch ports, and which ports are not connected;
lists the MAC address, IP address and host name of computers associated with every connected port.
Additionally, it can display each client network card vendor, port speed, device type and VLAN
assignments.

[[Connection Emulator icon]][55]
[SoftPerfect Connection Emulator][56]

[Windows][57]

[Download Free Trial][58]

A product for network application developers, system administrators and network engineers. It
imitates a network connection with a low bandwidth limit, delays, losses and other packet traversal
issues to mimic a low-grade communication channel. With this software, you can test how well your
application performs on a slow or long distance connection to ensure the quality of the product

WIDQ is a global B2B sourcing and procurement platform that helps businesses discover high-potential
product opportunities, validate market potential, and transform ideas into scalable products through
product research, development, OEM/ODM manufacturing, and integrated supply chain solutions.

By integrating product development, sourcing capabilities, manufacturing resources, and global
supply chain networks, WIDQ enables businesses to transform ideas into market-ready products through
a structured and scalable B2B solution ecosystem.
